body: ac-01: prepare_multibranch_data.py — replace 512-dim Model2Vec embed slot with frozen gte-tiny 384-dim value embedding, EMBED_DIM 384, VERSION_V5. Then ac-02 model embed_dim + retrain, ac-03 offline gate vs v19.

ac-01 in progress (remote-control 2026-06-20). Rust train-data reader + read_ftmb.py accept FTMB v5 (byte-identical to v4, version=5, embed_dim=384 gte-tiny marker). Built scripts/build_ftmb_v5_gte.py: monkeypatches prepare_multibranch_data to run v19's EXACT recipe (overnight_v19_paired.sh args) with only the embed slot swapped to frozen gte-tiny 384-dim (CPU, mean-pool over values, lock-serialized inside the ThreadPoolExecutor). Smoke PASSED: format round-trip via read_ftmb.py + 1-epoch Rust train on a 120-rec v5 ('Loaded ... 384 embed ... 40 table groups'). FINDING: taxonomy drifted 240->244 since v19 (plain_text+datetime leaves); VALID_DIM=240 in prepare script is stale, builder pins it live from extract-features. Full build running -> output/multibranch-training/v5-gte-blend.ftmb (log: output/gte-tiny-embed-swap/build_v5.log).

ac-01 DONE + verified 2026-06-20. v5-gte-blend.ftmb: 131,831 cols / 16,788 groups, embed=384 gte-tiny, valid=244, 0 errors, full parse 0 trailing bytes, min label 57. Result: output/gte-tiny-embed-swap/ac01_result.md. NEXT ac-02: train multi-branch on it; config = sherlock-v13-config.json with embed_dim=384 + valid_dim=244 (n_classes auto-derives to 244).

Best-release push: 3 free handicaps fixed (4-stat aggregation embed 384->1536; L2-norm gte=canonical; subsumes input-LN). Release candidate = gte-small FINE-TUNED value encoder (author choice). Fine-tune DONE (loss 3.26->0.81, 123 distilled types; saved gte_small_ft.pt). Held-out probe: frozen sep +0.058 vs fine-tuned +1.195 (20x). Builder wired (--encoder-checkpoint). Config models/gte-config-1536.json ready. ORCHESTRATION: floor build (frozen, ~85min) -> on done: floor single-seed train (MPS) + release feature build (CPU, --encoder-checkpoint gte_small_ft.pt) in parallel -> release train -> ac-03 gate.

PHASE: floor train (models/gte-floor-s42, MPS) + release feature build (v5-gte-ft-blend.ftmb, fine-tuned gte-small encoder, CPU) running in parallel. ac-03 BLOCKER identified: scoring a gte model needs a PRECOMPUTED-FEATURE predict path (profile/predict use Model2Vec 512, gte model needs 1536) — does not exist. PLAN: new Rust subcommand predict-multi-branch (load MultiBranchModel via VarBuilder::from_mmaped_safetensors + config.json + FrozenSiblingContext::load; read_training_data ftmb; apply sibling-context per group to 128-dim header feats THEN forward_trunk(char,embed,stats,header,valid,train=false)->argmax->label via label_map.json). VALIDATE by reproducing ~train_acc on the floor FTMB before trusting gold. Then: gold/repr FTMB builder (one record/col, gte 1536 feats, label=join id) -> predict -> score_gold_anchor score vs v19 0.798/0.691. Load-bearing (H03).

ac-03 scoring pipeline COMPLETE + validated. predict_multibranch (Rust, reuses exact training forward) reproduced 0.9497 on floor model's own FTMB (train 0.953/val 0.926) -> forward correct. build_gold_ftmb.py builds per-column singleton-group v5 FTMB. FLOOR (gte-floor-s42, frozen gte-tiny+fixes, val_acc 0.9264) STANDALONE gold = 0.532/931. KEY: standalone != v19's 0.798 COMPOSED (Sharpen rules add ~0.27; floor composed est ~0.75-0.80). ac-03 proxy = floor-vs-release standalone (isolates fine-tune). RELEASE candidate (gte-release-s42, fine-tuned gte-small, 20x separation) TRAINING epoch 3 val 0.885 ~2h to standalone number. Then: if release>>floor -> GO proxy -> ac-04 (candle gte in-binary) for composed gate vs v19. See memory ac03-standalone-vs-composed-gate.

TWO-VIEW OVERNIGHT launched in tmux 'two_view' (2026-06-20 ~20:54 local). Bet: embed = frozen gte-tiny(1536) ++ ft gte-small(1536) = 3072, model weights views per type. Ablation evidence: frozen wins 76 cols, ft wins 63; oracle ceiling 0.599 std (~0.85 composed) vs floor 0.532. Pipeline (scripts/overnight_two_view.sh): build binaries -> build 3072 FTMB (guarded embed=3072/valid=244) -> 3-seed train (models/gte-twoview-s42/43/44, gte-config-3072.json) -> build two-view gold FTMB -> score each seed standalone gold. Smoke-validated: 3072 reader proof (1-epoch Rust train 'Loaded ... 3072 embed'). Log: output/gte-tiny-embed-swap/overnight_two_view.log. GO if a seed clears floor by >CI(~+0.03) toward 0.599 -> ac-04 compose. No model-code change.

TWO-VIEW RESULT (2026-06-21): QUALIFIED GO. 3-seed standalone gold 0.571/0.536/0.524 vs floor 0.532 (best seed 42 +0.039, clears gate, 65% to oracle 0.599). Beats wholesale swap (0.518=floor). Mechanism CONFIRMED: seed 42 uses both views — recovered numeric +0.48/utc +0.40/longitude +0.17 (format) AND kept currency +0.39/codes/url (semantic). GAPS: (1) seed-fragile, 1/3 clears floor; (2) postal -0.40/latitude -0.30 still regress — no gte view helps numeric-RANGE. NEXT BET: 3-view embed (format-aware ++ frozen ++ semantic) targets the range gap; do NOT build ac-04 on a fragile single seed. Result: output/gte-tiny-embed-swap/twoview_result.md. Models gte-twoview-s{42,43,44}.
